moves.what_it_does: Relaunch a worker with a reviewed serving profile (model, parser, chat template, flags and limits). Repairs a worker whose configuration differs from the reviewed one. Takes the worker out of rotation while it restarts.

payload.expected_effect: target-a will be re-launched with enable_auto_tool_choice set to true (matching the reviewed configuration). The structured tool-call canary should then pass, returning target-a to full health. Users on target-a will no longer see HTTP 400 errors from tool calls.
payload.reasoning: target-a has a confirmed misconfigured flag (enable_auto_tool_choice false vs. reviewed true) that causes the tool-call canary to fail with HTTP 400. The only available repair move is to apply a reviewed serving profile, which will re-launch target-a with the correct configuration. target-b is healthy and requires no action. Applying the profile to target-a restores service for users by fixing the root cause.
payload.risk: The worker will be taken out of rotation during restart, causing a brief interruption. If the profile name or contents are incorrect for the current deployment, the worker may fail to start, but the profile name matches the pattern expected for this type of repair.
